sites.source: https://wvdnr.gov/lands-waters/wildlife-management-areas/district-6-wildlife-management-areas/ ('78. Conaway Run Lake ... On the WMA: campsites - 10 primitive; vault toilets'), read 2026-10-21

note: WV DNR primitive campground at Conaway Run Lake Wildlife Management Area near Middlebourne (Tyler County), beside a small fishing lake. --Claude
summary: DNR's District 6 WMA page confirms 10 primitive campsites and vault toilets (agency-designated campsites, not a lot allowance), so ownership state stands; the phone (304) 420-4550 is the District 6 office on the same page (76 Conservation Way, Parkersburg). Not stated: hookups/water (derived 'none' left), fees, season, reservations, rig size. Note trimmed of the site count, toilets and no-water/no-hookup restatements.
flags: Criteria: no DNR page says whether a 23-ft motorhome fits the 10 primitive sites (the page says only 'campsites - 10 primitive').
